// diagnostic

E3406

The name given to `perf.{member}` is not a string literal.

What

The name given to `perf.{member}` is not a string literal.

Why

A zone's or plot's name is its site's: the program passes the literal's text as it is, so naming a site allocates nothing and every row of the site carries the same name on the `jet perf view` timeline.

Fix

Write the name as a string literal, such as `perf.{member}("physics")`; to tell cases apart, give each its own site and name.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3406: Tests/UI/E3406_perf_zone_name_not_literal.stderr.
